name: Sing VL S1 4B

lineage.how_derived: multimodal decision model: choice, noul (yes/no) and score (2-10 levels) answered per named question over text or JSON and up to four images

purpose: Typed decisions with a probability per candidate; a batch engine groups prompts by length with a 65,536 padded-token budget per forward pass (card).

license.name: not stated
license.notes: No license field and no LICENSE file in the HF repo.

pc-12gb.notes: 9.1 GB against a VRAM budget of 9.6 GB (VRAM minus about 2.4 GB), KV cache not included

pc-16gb.notes: 9.1 GB against a VRAM budget of 13.6 GB (VRAM minus about 2.4 GB), KV cache not included

pc-24gb.notes: 9.1 GB against a VRAM budget of 21.6 GB (VRAM minus about 2.4 GB), KV cache not included

pc-32gb.notes: 9.1 GB against a VRAM budget of 29.6 GB (VRAM minus about 2.4 GB), KV cache not included

mac-16-24gb.notes: 9.1 GB against a GPU share of about 12 GB (KV cache not included)

mac-32gb.notes: 9.1 GB against a GPU share of about 22 GB (KV cache not included)

mac-64gb+.notes: 9.1 GB against a GPU share of about 52 GB (KV cache not included)

benchmarks.name: Decision Index 0.3 public text / vision
benchmarks.variant: 65,536-token batch engine, 1.6 MP image cap; table lists Perplexity Decider Flash 4B vision 72.5 and StartLux 4B 67.9

strengths: A decision model reads a state (text, JSON, images) and a schema of typed questions and returns calibrated probabilities for every option in one forward pass; it does not generate text.
leads the 4B decision models on the vendor's vision numbers
soft.maturity: 1.8k downloads, 6 likes; earlier skipped as a research artifact, recorded here for the Decision Index comparison

tona_fit.reason: No licence stated, so it cannot be offered; revisit if inclusionAI adds one.
